headline: Accenture (ACN) Expands Banking Role With UniCredit And IBM Partnership
summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has agreed to a new collaboration with UniCredit and IBM to build a next generation banking platform in Europe. IBM will work on modernizing UniCredit’s technology stack as part of this multi year initiative.
